finding.issue: Existing thread model selection could be adopted before thread/session or thread/read disclosed the original provider, delaying consent until resume/send.

resolution: setOptions now refuses only changes to model/modelProvider while the existing thread source provider is unknown. It leaves the old selection intact and explains that the read must finish before choosing again. Other draft options remain editable.
When the provider read finishes, choosing the different provider immediately opens the original confirmation dialog before storing options. No queued automatic candidate-selection intent was added.

Actual App fixture now includes mandatory native thread.modelProvider and the session provider. Its removed-provider scenario explicitly uses the removed identity, confirms selection, and verifies exact top-level consent while retaining same-thread, no-turn, no-new-conversation and draft assertions.

validation.scope: Includes real useConversation + Api with deferred thread/read, real ModelPicker, Dialog, draft persistence and operation journal; no mocked read-completion toggle for the new case.
16 confirmation cases plus 33 actual App lifecycle cases after protocol-shaped fixture correction.

limits: Only selection boundary and tests were edited in this repair; parent concurrent ROOT/mobile header changes in Workspace were preserved. Current whole-file hashes include that separately authored work.
No full suite, remote operation, deployment, paid inference or live history conversion.
